content: Pitfalls when splitting a single-file text/babel app: (1) execution is strictly document order, so split files must be tagged in dependency (topological) order; (2) top-level const/function declarations in classic scripts share the global lexical environment, so files can reference each other but names collide with the global scope — prefix internal helpers to avoid accidental shadowing; (3) no import/export statements inside text/babel files (Babel emits them into a classic script and the browser throws); (4) XHR loading means file:// double-click fails (CORS) — must keep serving over http; (5) unpinned CDN URLs (@latest, @18, bare babel.min.js) silently drift on cache-bust — pin exact versions; (6) lucide.createIcons() must re-run after React re-renders (existing onSnapshot setTimeout pattern must be preserved).
